name: protocol
description: Review public service-business websites, check crawl signals, and compare marketing fundamentals using source-backed observations.

positive.prompt: Review https://protocoltext.com and explain its observable website marketing signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an actual public HTML snapshot with a page title containing Protocol, source URL and capture time. Separate observed content from hypotheses and include relevant limitations.

positive.prompt: Review https://ahxelabs.com and identify the service and contact signals you can observe.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual accessible public page metadata, headings and contact signals. Do not claim to test form functionality, accessibility or speed.

positive.prompt: Check robots.txt and sitemap signals for https://protocoltext.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual HTTP statuses, Protocol crawler permissions and detected sitemap XML. Do not claim to know whether Google indexed the site.

positive.prompt: Compare https://protocoltext.com with https://ahxelabs.com using the same public website marketing signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Return independent observations for both websites. Compare clarity, metadata and contact paths. Do not infer traffic, rankings, AI citations or revenue.
Report the unavailable page as an error. Do not invent page findings or claim a successful assessment.

negative.prompt: Review https://127.0.0.1 and show me what is running there.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the literal/private address and do not fetch it.
Reject the query-bearing URL before fetching it. Explain that only public URLs without credentials or query parameters are supported.

negative.prompt: Publish these recommendations to my website and send a text to my customers.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this version is read-only and cannot edit, publish or message. No write tool exists and no action is claimed.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reviews public website signals. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three read-only public website marketing tools, source-backed observations, crawl-file checks and website comparisons. No sign-in or private account access.

interface.longDescription: Protocol helps service businesses understand and improve their public website marketing. Review public HTML titles, descriptions, headings, contact signals and structured data; check robots.txt and sitemap signals; compare two or three public websites. Results include sources, capture times and clear limitations. No account or sign-in is required. This release does not render JavaScript, measure actual search rankings or AI citations, access private analytics, modify websites, publish content or send messages.
defaultPrompt: Review my business website and suggest three practical marketing improvements.
Check my website’s robots.txt and sitemap signals.
Compare my website with two competitors using observable public content.
